segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports that even at 54 her acne does not stop, but this product controls it when a pimple appears.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer who purchased the sensitive-skin version reports it worked less well for her than the regular-strength Proactiv she had used before.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s and 60s report continued or newly emerging acne well into adulthood, with two describing their skin as clearer than it has been in years after months of consistent use.

concerns.aging: One reviewer mentions her mother also uses this gel as an anti-aging product, though this is a secondhand, single mention.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers frequently report the treatment is drying, several specifically recommending pairing it with a moisturizer to offset this; one reviewer, however, reports it did not dry her skin out the way other products had.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports severe, persistent redness alongside a painful breakout that had not resolved even two months later; by contrast, most other reviewers report their skin looking clearer and calmer without new redness.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with over 20 years of hyperpigmentation reports it visibly fading and her skin evening out within three weeks of use, after trying many other products without success.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, including several with long-standing hormonal or cystic acne, report significant to complete clearing within two weeks to a few months of consistent use; however, a notable minority report the opposite: one had a severe, painful breakout with redness and permanent scarring that had not resolved even two months later, another broke out and returned the product, and a couple report it simply did not work or only helped a little.
